checklist.item: Queries. EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN for every query on the request path and at startup. Flag every full table scan (SCAN) and every temporary B-tree (USE TEMP B-TREE) over results.
checklist.evidence: pulse-status has no database: grep -rn "sqlite\|bun:sqlite\|Database" src/*.ts | grep -v test (exit 0) finds only the function name readDatabase (src/settings-poll.ts:107), an HTTP read. The api-side plans of the reads status makes are in audits/performance/api.md. Checked instead: 100 concurrent GET / plus 90 /api requests caused one upstream read per path (fake api counts {"/checks":2,...all others 1}), so the documented single flight per cache period holds.

checklist.item: Startup. A CPU profile of the startup (bun --cpu-prof), with the top functions by self time.
checklist.evidence: Bench startup_cpu_ms B 260 ms (230-270), budget 377 ms: ok. Local CPU at first /readyz 200: 100-110 ms at 20, 200 and 1000 checks (3 runs each), no growth with data. timeout 300 bun grow.ts <copy> <api> prof-20 3 0 false 18421 <dir> (bun --cpu-prof --cpu-prof-interval=100 src/main.ts, exit 0), 3 runs at 20 and 1000 checks. Top self time at 20 checks (936 samples, 278.5 ms): anonymous native 29.5 %, _onceWrap node:events 7.1 %, node:util 6.7 %, DateTimeFormat (src/ssr.ts:19-40) 4.8 %, zod init 1.8 %. By file: runtime 36.5 %, zod 18.8 %, src/main.ts 8.2 %, pulse-kit 6.4 %, pulse-contract 5.4 %, src/ssr.ts 4.8 %. No finding.

checklist.item: Costs that grow with data. The repository's bench, or a local A/B with a larger data set (for example 10x the bench seed). Report how each measured cost changes with the data size.
checklist.evidence: Repository bench bench/proxy-cache.ts and bench/conditional.ts at 100 checks and a copy at 1000 checks (3 runs each, exit 0): cached /api/uptime 205-220 -> 1063-1185 ms per 300 requests; /api/checks 304 68-82 -> 72-87 ms; /badge/check-0.svg 304 515-521 -> 3858-4916 ms. Local A/B with a fake api at 20 (bench seed), 200 (10x) and 1000 checks (bun grow.ts, 3 runs default layout, 2 runs checks shown, exit 0): page 53,281 / 480,016 / 1,526,457 B (shown 267,012 / 2,616,442 / 8,879,289 B); rebuild median CPU 25 / 90 / 130 ms (shown 30 / 155 / 365 ms); warm p95 0.52-0.57 / 0.82-0.98 / 1.95-2.30 ms; 10-visitor CPU per 60 s 0.71-0.75 / 2.20-2.39 / 2.86-3.09 s; VmHWM 87.8-88.5 / 140.7-143.6 / 175.0-180.8 MiB; 120 of 610 requests 502 at 1000 checks. Conditional badge/feed server CPU per 304 (bun badge.ts, 3 runs): check badge 0.53-0.60 / 3.53-3.57 / 13.20-17.13 ms; feed 0.60-0.63 / 4.47-4.60 / 24.17-24.83 ms; /api/checks 0.07-0.13 ms flat. Findings 2, 4 and 5.

checklist.item: Memory over time. RSS after N minutes of steady load, against the RSS at the start. Name N and the load.
checklist.evidence: timeout 420 bun mem.ts (3 processes at once, exit 0). N = 5 minutes. Load: 10 visitors, each GET / once per minute and the 10 /api paths every 5 s (6,050 requests, 0 failed), default settings and layout; plus an idle process without requests. 20 checks idle: RSS 65.2 -> 63.0 MiB, VmHWM 64.9 MiB, 0.058 s CPU per minute. 20 checks load: RSS 64.9 at start, 84.6 at 30 s, 79.5-84.6 until 300 s (83.4), VmHWM 95.5 MiB, 0.55 s CPU per minute. 200 checks load: RSS 65.4 at start, 104.8-116.9 MiB from 30 to 270 s, 143.8 MiB at 300 s, VmHWM 155.0 MiB, 1.95 s CPU per minute. No leak shown. Finding 3.
